import json, threading, os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from baml_py import BamlRuntime, ClientRegistry
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Literal
from types import ModuleType
class Greeting(BaseModel):
    message: Literal["Hello, World!"]
models=ModuleType("models")
models.Greeting=Greeting
enums=ModuleType("enums")
from pathlib import Path
requests=[]
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def log_message(self,*args): pass
 def do_POST(self):
  request=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
  requests.append(request)
  body=json.dumps({"id":"corpus-fixture","object":"chat.completion","created":0,"model":"local-fixture","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":json.dumps({"message":"Hello, World!" if len(requests)==1 else "Unexpected"})},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}).encode()
  self.send_response(200)
  self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
  self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body)))
  self.end_headers()
  self.wfile.write(body)
srv=HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Handler)
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
registry=ClientRegistry()
registry.add_llm_client("Fixture","openai-generic",{"base_url":f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}/v1","api_key":"synthetic-test","model":"local-fixture"})
registry.set_primary("Fixture")
runtime=BamlRuntime.from_files(".", {name:Path(name).read_text() for name in ("hello.baml","generators.baml")}, {})
ctx=runtime.create_context_manager()
value=runtime.call_function_sync("Hello",{"name":"World"},ctx,None,registry,[],{},{})
assert value.is_ok(),value.unstable_internal_repr()
parsed=value.cast_to(enums,models,models,False,runtime)
assert parsed.message=="Hello, World!", repr(parsed)
assert len(requests)==1 and "This is a greeting for World." in json.dumps(requests)
try:
 bad=runtime.call_function_sync("Hello",{"name":"Other"},ctx,None,registry,[],{},{})
 bad.cast_to(enums,models,models,False,runtime)
except Exception as error:
 assert "Unexpected" in str(error) or "literal" in str(error).lower(), repr(error)
else:
 raise AssertionError("BAML accepted a wrong string literal")
assert "This is a greeting for Other." in json.dumps(requests[1])
print(parsed.message)
srv.shutdown()

semantic_scope: The official native BAML SDK rendered prompts from the original BAML definitions, called an isolated synthetic HTTP fixture, parsed the valid typed response and rejected a different string literal. The check covers prompt interpolation and response validation.
